text:
Today the moon looks at me

white and measureless.


It is the same as last night,

the same as tomorrow.


But it is other, for never

was it so large and so pale.


I tremble as the lights

tremble over the waters.


I tremble as in the eyes

tears usually tremble.


I tremble as in the flesh

the soul knows how to tremble.


Oh! the moon has moved

its two silver lips.


Oh! the moon has told me

the three old words:


"Death, love and mystery..."

Oh, my flesh is ending!


Over dead flesh

my soul arches.


Soul — nocturnal cat —

leaps over the moon.


It goes through long skies

sad and curled up.


It goes through long skies

over the white moon.

translation.title: Journey
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the nursery-like repetitions turning into lunar disembodiment.
